tabs.html:
MikroTik hEX PoE lite (RB750UPr2) – Compact & Powerful PoE Router

Efficient Networking with Built-in PoE Support

The MikroTik hEX PoE lite (RB750UPr2) is a compact and affordable PoE router designed for home users, small businesses, and enterprise networks. Equipped with a 650MHz CPU, 64MB RAM, and 16MB Flash storage, this router provides stable and reliable performance for your network needs.


With five (5) LAN ports, including four (4) PoE-out ports, and one (1) USB port, the hEX PoE lite allows seamless device connectivity while eliminating the need for additional power adapters. Running on RouterOS L4, it offers advanced networking features, firewall security, and bandwidth management.


Key Features 

  • PoE-Out on 4 LAN Ports – Powers IP cameras, wireless access points, and VoIP phones, reducing cable clutter and extra power adapters.
  • Reliable Performance – Features a 650MHz processor and 64MB RAM for smooth network operations.
  • 5 Fast Ethernet LAN Ports – Supports high-speed wired connections for home and business networks.
  • USB Port for Extra Connectivity – Connects modems, storage devices, or other peripherals.
  • RouterOS L4 License – Offers advanced security, firewall, VPN support, and traffic control.
  • Compact & Durable Plastic Case – Lightweight and designed for efficient space utilization.
  • Plug & Play Power Adapter – Easy installation with an included power adapter.
  • Trusted MikroTik Quality – Manufactured in Latvia and China, ensuring high standards and reliability.
  •  12-Month Warranty – Backed by a one-year limited warranty for peace of mind.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: hEX PoE lite (RB750UPr2)
  • CPU: 650MHz Processor
  • RAM: 64MB
  • Storage: 16MB Flash
  • Ethernet Ports: 5 x LAN (Four with PoE-Out)
  • USB Port: 1 x USB for external devices
  • PoE-Out Ports: 4 x PoE-Out for powering devices
  • Operating System: RouterOS L4 License
  • Casing: Plastic
  • Power Supply: Adapter Included
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia, China
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Home & Office Networking – Provides fast and secure connectivity for multiple devices.
  • PoE Device Integration – Powers IP cameras, access points, and VoIP phones without additional power sources.
  • Advanced Firewall & VPN Support – Ensures secure remote access and corporate security.
  • Cost-Effective Power Management – Reduces the need for extra adapters and power supplies.


Why Choose MikroTik hEX PoE lite (RB750UPr2)?

  • Compact, Affordable, & Powerful – A feature-packed PoE router at a budget-friendly price.
  • PoE-Out Functionality – Eliminates the need for separate power adapters.
  • Fast & Reliable Performance – Ensures stable network connectivity.
  • Ideal for Small Businesses & Home Users – Supports advanced networking features.
